findings.claim: RUNTIME-ADDRESS RESOLVER (deliverable 1): the relocated OR-blit base is recovered PER RUN — with NO hardcoded address — by write-watching the off-screen compose page (linear 0x41820, cs:[0x14d] seg 0x4182) during a render and finding the OR plane-0 store's UNIQUE 4-SIBLING CLUSTER. The OR-blit's four planar byte-stores are at ega.drv FILE offsets 0xb31/0xb45/0xb5c/0xb75 (the `lodsb; or al,es:[di]; stosb` loop, one per EGA plane). A relocated copy preserves those relative offsets, so among the compose-page writer cseips, the one whose (cseip-0xb31) also has +0xb45/+0xb5c/+0xb75 siblings present IS the OR plane-0 store; base = cseip - 0xb31, OR-blit entry (dispatch entry 15, FUN_0a93) = base + 0xa93. This DEFEATS the documented '0 hits' wall: a fixed file-offset breakpoint on the in-image ega.drv copy (OR-store at 0x6acdd, base 0x6a1b0) logs 0 hits during the first render (verified) because the render runs from the RELOCATED copy (base 0x6ba10, OR-store 0x6c541). The resolver finds the live relocated copy from its own writes.

Probe: trace of in-image OR-store 0x6acdd during the genuine first render = 0 hits; the relocated copy is the active one. resolveOrBaseFirstRender (write-watch 0x41820..0x49820, action = the state-4->5 ENTER): the 4-sibling cluster recovers base=0x6ba10 (plane-0 store 0x6c541, entry 0x6c4a3). findings.claim: EXPANDER (Gap A record->work-buffer transform) LOCATED to the relocated ega.drv code region, observable ONLY at the genuine FIRST render. On the settled REPLAY path the OR-blit source work buffers are already resident (a write-watch on the source segment over a forceRedraw = 0 writers) — so the per-image wb-*.bin captures ARE the clean, final expander OUTPUT (this is why the existing replay-based decoder reaches byte-exact). The EXPAND itself runs only at first render: write-watching the work-buffer heap (0x20000..0x40000, excluding the compose page) during the state-4->5 render shows the top dest-SPAN writers are all in the relocated ega.drv segment (base 0x6ba10): cseips base+0xfab (0x6c9bb-0x6c9be), base+0x480 (0x6be90/0x6beb5/0x6bed7/0x6be4d), base+0x7..0x1f (0x6ba17/0x6ba2b/0x6ba2f), each sweeping a CONTIGUOUS ~0x117c-0x119a (4476-4506) byte range at 0x2060e..0x217bc — a full work-buffer fill. This REFINES maze-background-generation.json's 'the expander is an unpinned wmaze routine': the per-render work-buffer fill executes inside the relocated ega.drv copy (the same blit infra), driven by wmaze. The on-disk record (the expander INPUT) is loaded by the DOS file-read path (BIOS cs=f000 ip=1481, ax=0x4200 lseek) into a load buffer in the same heap window during first render. Gap A's next pass: trace base+0xfab / base+0x480 at first render, capture their (ds:si) input vs (es:di) output to read the masked-decompress loop — the harness already captures the OUTPUT side reproducibly.
